summary_en: 600,000 shares (2.16% of shares outstanding) to be acquired at up to ¥2.0B via open-market purchase through securities-company investment-discretion method. Execution window: 4 August – 30 November 2026. Stated rationale: flexible capital-allocation execution and capital-efficiency improvement.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On 3 August 2026, Nishio Holdings announced a share buyback program approved by its board of directors. The company will acquire up to 600,000 ordinary shares (2.16% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) for an aggregate sum not to exceed ¥2.0 billion. The acquisition will be conducted via open-market purchase through a securities-company investment-discretion method during the period from 4 August 2026 through 30 November 2026. The stated rationale is to enable flexible capital-allocation execution and improve capital efficiency, thereby enhancing shareholder value. As of 30 June 2026, the company held 628,293 treasury shares against 27,763,171 shares outstanding (excluding treasury).
